newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos to auction unique souvenir.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos to auction unique souvenir.

text.p: It looks like a piece of curled macaroni but Philippine President Fidel Ramos says he plans to auction the lump of cholesterol surgeons scraped off an artery in his neck, saving him from a possible stroke.
"I'm preserving a relic here which I will use for fund raising for a worthy purpose," Ramos told reporters, showing them the accumulated cholesterol fat he had preserved in a bottle of formalin.
"Looks like a piece of macaroni," he said during a belated Christmas party he hosted at the presidential palace for the media at the weekend.

Doctors have said the cholesterol blockage in a major artery that supplies blood to the brain could have caused a massive stroke had it not been removed. Ramos was operated on a week ago and has since been discharged.
The president's wife, Amelita, said Ramos planned to use the proceeds from the auction to finance projects for Manila slum dwellers.
Ramos did not say who might be interested in buying the unique presidential souvenir which some reporters said looked like a strand of spaghetti.
